Interview Notice
With reference to the Advertisement Notice No: F (NMHS-CBT Project)KU/2026, dated:
17-04-2026 under the GBP-NIHE, MoEFCC-sponsored research project “Rehabilitation of
Degraded Alpine Grasslands using Ecosystem-based Solutions for Sustaining Ecosystem
Services and Ecological Resilience across Western Himalaya” under the NMHS Scheme, the
interview for the temporary positions of Research Associate-I and Junior Project Fellow is
scheduled to be held on Tuesday, 12-05-2026 from 02:00 PM onwards in the office chamber of
Dean, School of Biological Sciences, University of Kashmir . Furthermore, no TA/DA will be
paid for appearing in the interview.
Sd/
